item.title: Want to build muscle but also wanna keep a lean face
item.description: Glewin07: Did u stay at maintenance I never paid much attention to how much I was eating, except I increased the protein significantly. Three years after I started lifting weights I began competing in Bodybuilding contests (about 3 contests every year.) After every contest I allowed my body to return to about 15% body fat. I always stayed about 8 weeks out from contest shape at my “fattest.”
